newsitem.title: UK: Dlr boosted by Greenspan comments at Europe close.
newsitem.headline: Dlr boosted by Greenspan comments at Europe close.

text.p: The dollar rose sharply at the European close as dealers took comments by Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan as a hint that U.S. interest rates will be raised to nip inflation in the bud, analysts said.
In his semi-annual Humphrey-Hawkins testimony Greenspan said U.S. economic prospects were "quite favourable" but warned of inflation risks and voiced concern about soaring stock prices.
"The dollar got a boost because the market took his comments as implying that U.S. rates will go go up soon," said Michael O'Hanlon, chief international economist at Paine Webber.
